hero.heading: Mum, You Are Our Light & Inspiration
hero.writeup: To the woman who gave us everything, whose gentle smile has been our steadfast compass, and whose infinite warmth has turned our lives into something miraculous. Today, on December 23rd, we celebrate you with all our hearts.

sections.subtitle: First Daughter
sections.title: Lolo (Ada Ukwuaziza)
sections.narrative: Dearest Mum, words cannot begin to capture the depth of my gratitude and love for you. You have been our pillar of strength, our comfort, and our greatest inspiration. Everything I am and aspire to be is because of your unwavering love and sacrifices.
sections.quote: “To the queen of our hearts, the woman whose grace guides us every day.”

sections.subtitle: Devotion & Grace
sections.title: A Supportive Wife
sections.narrative:
Happy birthday to my beautiful wife, my partner and the mother of our children. ❤️

I am grateful to God for the woman you are and for the life we have built together. Watching you love and care for our family is something I never take for granted. You have been a wonderful wife, a loving mother, and a strong pillar of this family.

Thank you for standing by me, for all the sacrifices you make, and for the love you continue to give us every day. I pray that God blesses you with good health, peace, happiness and many more beautiful years.

May this new chapter bring you everything your heart desires. I love you, and I’m grateful to have you as my wife.

Happy birthday, my love. ❤️
sections.quote: “May this new chapter bring you everything your heart desires. I love you, and I’m grateful to have you as my wife.”

childrenTributes.name: Kenechukwu (Kenebom)
childrenTributes.narrative:
Happy birthday mum.

You have been so so supportive, caring and all I could ever wish for in a mum, on your special day all I wish is peace and good health.

Everyday should be a special day for you ❤️
childrenTributes.quote: “Everyday should be a special day for you ❤️”

childrenTributes.name: Second Daughter
childrenTributes.narrative:
One striking character you have is that you always support anyone, even when you don't understand exactly what they're doing. As far as it will make you happy and isn't evil, mummy will support you 100 %

Happy birthday Mummy🥹
Thank you for all your sacrifices and ceaseless love.
Keep basking in the beauty of the Lord.💙
childrenTributes.quote: “Thank you for all your sacrifices and ceaseless love. Keep basking in the beauty of the Lord.💙”

childrenTributes.name: Second Son
childrenTributes.narrative:
Happy birthday Mummy 🤭.

We thank God for adding 1 year to ur life and making you look younger as if he took ur years backwards

Enjoy your day and don't enter kitchen today oo, Daddy will take care anything you need today

Many more years to reap the fruit of ur labour
childrenTributes.quote: “Many more years to reap the fruit of ur labour”

childrenTributes.name: Third Son
childrenTributes.narrative:
Mummy, being the last born will always make me feel like I have a special place in your heart 😂❤️. Thank you for all the love, care, sacrifices, and prayers you’ve given me and the whole family.

You deserve all the love and happiness in the world.

Happy birthday, Mummy. I love you so much ❤️🥹. May this new year of your life be filled with everything your heart desires.
childrenTributes.quote: “You deserve all the love and happiness in the world.”

gallery.title: Cherished Moment with Mum
gallery.caption: Radiant smile on a peaceful afternoon

gallery.title: Tending Her Garden of Roses
gallery.caption: Mum arranging pastel blooms in the kitchen. Her patience with flowers mirrors the gentle care she has poured into each of us.

gallery.title: Surrounded by Love & Laughter
gallery.caption: All of us gathered around the table, celebrating Mum's infectious laughter and radiant joy under warm candlelight.

gallery.title: Peaceful Coastal Walk
gallery.caption: Walking along the seaside with the ocean breeze in her hair and a serene smile on her face. Pure peace.

gallery.title: Sweet Little Moments
gallery.caption: The tenderest embrace—sharing generational love and endless giggles on a sunny Sunday afternoon.
